items.title: Trump to meet with oil executives on lowering gas prices — and Exxon isn't invited
items.summary: President Trump is meeting with several oil executives on Tuesday to discuss expanding refining capacity in the US, with the goal of lowering gas prices. This comes after the US entered a major oil deal (CL=F, BZ=F) with Venezuela, buying up a large portion of the country's oil production rights. Yahoo Finance Washington Correspondent Ben Werschkul outlines all the key details of the meeting.
